::: {#exr-risk-difference-switch-ref}

Let:

- $\risk_1$ and $\risk_2$ be the [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1 and group 2.
- $\RD \eqdef \risk_1 - \risk_2$ be the [risk difference](#def-risk-difference) of group 1 compared with group 2.

Express the risk difference of group 2 compared with group 1, $\risk_2 - \risk_1$, in terms of $\RD$.

:::
